# Oxide Launcher 1.15.0

## ONIGAMI (Vulkan)

Renderer display name is now ONIGAMI (Vulkan) and it requires the Vulkan graphics API. Global pick asks (Cancel / Switch to Vulkan) and switches both settings together; instance pick auto-pins that instance to Vulkan without touching globals. Launch log records renderer + graphics API.

## Frame pacing

New VSync pacing toggle (swap-interval floor, default on) plus frame-pacing diagnostics every 600 swaps to investigate low frame rates.

## Rendering

Simple-path renderer (no vault/coalescing by default), always-forward state, sRGB write-control forwarding, honest basevertex rebase for multi-draw terrain. Upscaling and frame generation investigated and intentionally not shipped (no measured backend).
